title: Power Law Returns
hook: Most of your bets won't matter. One or two will matter more than all the rest combined.
statement: In many markets, a few outcomes beat everything else by a huge margin.
explainer: Investors see it in their returns. App stores see it in revenue. If results follow a power law, spreading resources evenly is a mistake. Spread small, then go big behind the winners.
sop: Check whether your market behaves like a power law.
Place lots of small, independent bets.
Put real resources behind the few outliers.
Reinvest the wins into more shots, not lifestyle.
equation_example: 15 bets this year, and the top 2 produced 85% of total value. So Portfolio Value is basically your top 1 to 3 outcomes. More concentration means find and fund the outlier. A flatter spread means no power law, or no outlier yet.
question: List your bets from this year and circle the one or two producing most of the value.
closing_statement: A few outcomes will always outweigh the average one.
caption:
Principle Nº 315: Power Law Returns

Most of your bets won't matter. One or two will matter more than all the rest combined.

In many markets, a few outcomes beat everything else by a huge margin.
